Inherit definitions on all current and future profiles (on) or stop (off)

Usage: larp cc mcp sync-all [OPTIONS] <MODE>

Arguments:
  <MODE>  [possible values: on, off]

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
